planDetail.t1Quote: Because the plan was so clear, I never had to wonder what to study each day. I finally found my routine.
planDetail.t2Quote: Reading and vocabulary progressed together, so I could actually measure my score improving.
planDetail.t3Quote: Live classes plus the AI study plan made it much easier to stay on track. The plan detail page also made my decision easy.
planDetail.faq1Q: When does my access start after I buy a plan?
planDetail.faq1A: Access is added to your account once the payment is recorded. Activation is checked by our team and completed shortly.
planDetail.faq2Q: Can I switch between monthly and yearly billing?
planDetail.faq2A: Yes. You can move to a higher plan or a different billing cycle later, depending on your needs.
planDetail.faq3Q: If the plan content changes, does it affect my subscription?
planDetail.faq3A: Plan updates apply to new purchases. Changes for existing subscriptions are handled separately.
planDetail.faq4Q: Will I get support after paying?
planDetail.faq4A: Yes. Depending on your plan, support continues for live classes, AI planning and content follow-up.
planDetail.faq5Q: How long are live classes each week, and can I buy single classes?
planDetail.faq5A: Plans with live classes include a total of 4 hours of live lessons per week. You can also buy single live classes outside a plan.
